Revenue: $526.5 Million, above high end of range

Weighted Common Shares: 71 Million, right on target

model_answer:
Need the full details; fetch Q3 and Q4 letters.Lemonade's FY2024 results came in at or above the top of the full-year guidance it gave with its Q3 2024 results (October 30, 2024). That guidance raised gross earned premium and revenue and reaffirmed everything else.

| Metric (FY2024) | Q3 guidance (low–high) | Actual | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| In force premium | $940M–$944M | $943.7M | Within range, at the top |
| Gross earned premium | $823M–$826M | $827.3M | Above the high end |
| Revenue | $522M–$524M | $526.5M | Above the high end |
| Adjusted EBITDA loss | ($155M)–($151M) | About ($150M) | Slightly better than the best end |
| Stock-based compensation | ~$64M | $64.5M | In line |

The same pattern held for Q4 on its own:
- **Gross earned premium:** Q4 guidance was $222M–$225M, and the actual was $226.4M.
- **Revenue:** Q4 guidance was $144M–$146M, and the actual was $148.8M.
- **Adjusted EBITDA loss:** Q4 guidance was ($29M)–($25M), and the actual was ($23.8M).
- **Stock-based compensation:** Q4 guidance was about $16M, and the actual was $17.3M.

In the Q4 letter, Lemonade said it delivered on its guidance "with notable precision." The ($150M) full-year Adjusted EBITDA loss was a 13% improvement on the prior year. The company's own letter reports the full-year loss as ($150M), and I didn't find the exact figure to the decimal in the pages I read.

Sources: Lemonade's Q3 2024 and Q4 2024 shareholder letters.
